zh.title: ArcFlow · 把审批，接进你的业务
zh.description: 面向 Java 业务系统的开源审批项目。真实图流程设计器、条件分支与并行汇合，附可本地运行的付款审批示例、九种业务文档和 HTTP 接口参考。
zh.intro:
从流程设计，到每一次审批。
用看得见、跑得通的示例，搭起你的业务流程。
zh.heroNote: Apache-2.0 · 源码预览 · 自托管示例
zh.screenTitle: 分支看得见，汇合有依据。
zh.screenSub: 配置金额条件与独立审批路径，保存草稿、预览路线，再发布。这里展示已验收的真实界面原图。
zh.screenLabel: 真实界面 / 合成演示数据
proof: 配置条件、并行路径与审批人员
保存业务字段与流程版本快照
处理当前待办，保留每个人的决定
zh.designerTitle:
画出路径，
跑通每一次汇合。
zh.designerIntro: 在独立 Vue 工作区中，插入成对的条件或并行区域，配置人员与优先级。提交后冻结定义和所选路径；每条任务分别推进。
designerFeatures: 按分支顺序选择首个命中条件，最后保留默认分支。当前只使用付款净额 payment.netTotal。
并行分流与 ALL 汇合
各分支独立审批，全部到达后才继续；与人员组内的 ALL / ANY 表决规则分开。
保存草稿、检查、预览和发布；并发决定受版本检查保护，终态驳回会取消其他活动任务。
zh.designerLink: 图设计器契约与操作指南
zh.flowNote: 示意流程 · 顺序步骤，非通用并行网关
zh.scenariosTitle:
从一笔真实业务，
走完整个流程。
zh.scenariosIntro: 这里展示四组真实界面。当前主线共有九种业务文档：请假、采购与报价使用各自入口，另有六个独立场景工作区。
zh.screenNote: 9bb7a84a 真实验收原图 · 合成数据 · 点击放大；本页是静态展示，不运行 Java 审批服务。

scenarios.title: 把每笔费用，说清楚。
scenarios.body: 成本中心、币种、1–20 行费用明细，连同审批流程一起保存。通过、驳回与逐人记录，都有迹可循。
scenarios.boundary: 票据引用为文字，不上传或验真；审批通过不会打款。当前未接入若依与 H5。
scenarios.alt: 费用报销工作区：包含成本中心、币种和多行费用明细的已填写表单

scenarios.title: 从请假，理解每一步。
scenarios.body: 填写整天天数和事由，由当前审批人处理，再进入后续复核。待办和记录随身份切换。
scenarios.boundary: 这是审批示例，不计算考勤或假期余额，也不支持自动寻找直属主管。
scenarios.alt: 请假审批待办：左侧申请列表，右侧当前审批、流程顺序和操作记录

scenarios.title: 让采购申请，有据可审。
scenarios.body: 物品、数量、单价与币种，随申请进入审批。需要审批的业务信息与当时的流程一起保留。
scenarios.boundary: 示例不自动下单、付款或入库；审批结果需要由宿主业务继续处理。
scenarios.alt: 采购申请表：单项物品、数量、单价和币种字段

scenarios.title: 报价有调整，决策有记录。
scenarios.body: 核对源报价与申请价格，依次由销售经理和财务审核。业务读权与审批权限分别检查。
scenarios.boundary: 与共享工作区隔离；未连接真实 CRM，不自动报价、通知客户或回写业务。
scenarios.alt: 独立 CRM 报价折扣申请页，展示源报价、申请价格和审批说明

zh.architectureTitle:
内核、审批、界面。
各自做好自己的事。
zh.architectureIntro: 从最小的 Java 内核，到可运行的宿主示例。你可以看清依赖，再选择适合自己的接入层。
layers: 01 / ENGINE
同步 DAG 内核
按依赖顺序运行处理器，管理变量与事件。内核无第三方运行时依赖。
不承载人工等待或持久运行状态。
02 / DOMAIN
审批领域与存储
人员权限、顺序与结构化图流程、任务快照和审批记录。默认 JSON，可选 JDBC 适配器。
审批模块有自身依赖；JDBC 需要显式接线与迁移。
03 / EXPERIENCE
宿主与客户端
Spring Boot、Vue、若依与 H5 示例，展示不同系统的接入方式。
各客户端覆盖范围不同，不代表完整生产服务。
zh.capTitle:
能做什么，
也说清还不能做什么。
zh.capIntro: 开源的价值，也在于边界透明。把缺项算进接入计划，而不是上线后再发现。
caps: 顺序审批与结构化付款图
SINGLE / ALL / ANY 表决；条件选择、并行分流与配对汇合，保留版本与任务记录。
宿主与业务范围有边界
图流程仅独立付款工作区；原固定步骤的条件路由仍用于付款、收货与合同。若依和 H5 不自动获得图能力。
动态主管、撤回、转办、定时催办、BPMN 与自动业务回写。
zh.startTitle:
下一步，
跑一笔自己的申请。
zh.startIntro: 把图设计器在本地跑起来：编辑、发布，再发起付款申请，观察独立任务如何汇合。
zh.requirements: Linux / macOS / WSL · Git · Python 3.9+ · 完整 JDK 17+ · Maven 3.9+ · Node 22.22.2+（22.x，含 npm）

较早版本，提交 ab428327；不含图流程与其他后续主线更新。
启动、图流程边界、存储接线、实际 HTTP 接口与可执行合成示例。
zh.closing:
把下一条流程，
交给你来定义。
zh.closingBody: 读源码，跑示例，告诉我们你的使用场景。

en.title: ArcFlow · Bring approvals into your business
en.description: An open-source approval project for Java: a real graph designer, conditional branches and parallel joins, a local payment workflow example, nine business document types and HTTP API docs.
en.intro:
From the first step to the final decision.
Build on examples you can see, run, and understand.
en.screenTitle: See every branch. Understand every join.
en.screenSub: Set amount conditions and independent review paths. Save, preview and publish. These are original screenshots from the accepted implementation.
proof: Set conditions, parallel paths and reviewers
en.designerTitle:
Design the paths.
Follow them to the join.
en.designerIntro: Insert paired conditional or parallel regions in the standalone Vue workspace. Set people and branch priority. Each submitted request freezes its definition and selected paths while tasks progress independently.
designerFeatures: The first matching branch wins; the final branch is the default. Conditions currently use payment.netTotal only.
Branches progress independently. The join waits for every branch, separately from ALL / ANY voting within a reviewer group.
Save drafts, validate, preview and publish. Version checks protect concurrent decisions; terminal rejection cancels other active tasks.
en.flowNote: Illustrative sequence · Not a general parallel gateway
en.scenariosIntro: Explore four real interface examples here. Current main has nine business document types: leave, procurement and quotes use their own entry points, alongside six standalone scenario workspaces.
en.screenNote: Original acceptance capture at 9bb7a84a · Synthetic data · Click to enlarge. This static page does not run the Java approval service.

scenarios.title: Every expense, accounted for.
scenarios.body: A cost center, currency, and 1–20 expense lines, saved alongside the approval process. Follow decisions and individual review records.
scenarios.boundary: Receipt references are text, not uploads or validation. Approval never sends a payment. Not yet integrated with RuoYi or H5.
scenarios.alt: Completed expense form with cost center, currency, and multiple expense lines

scenarios.title: Start with a leave request.
scenarios.body: Enter whole days and a reason. The current reviewer makes a decision before the next step begins. Inbox and records follow the active identity.
scenarios.boundary: An approval example, without attendance calculations, leave balances, or automatic line-manager lookup.
scenarios.alt: Leave approval inbox with the request, current review step, workflow sequence, and history

scenarios.title: Give reviewers the details.
scenarios.body: An item, quantity, unit price, and currency travel with the request. Business details and the workflow are preserved as submitted.
scenarios.boundary: No automatic purchasing, payments, or inventory updates. The host business must handle the outcome.
scenarios.alt: Procurement request form for an item, quantity, unit price, and currency

scenarios.title: A price change with a record.
scenarios.body: Compare a source quote with the requested price, then review through sales management and finance. Business read access and approval rights are checked separately.
scenarios.boundary: Separate from the shared workspace. No live CRM connection, automatic quoting, customer notification, or business write-back.
scenarios.alt: Separate CRM quote-discount page with source quote, requested price, and review information

en.architectureTitle:
Engine. Domain. Interface.
Each with its own job.
en.architectureIntro: From a small Java engine to runnable host examples. See the dependencies, then choose the right layer for your application.
layers: 01 / ENGINE
Synchronous DAG engine
Runs handlers in dependency order, with variables and events. No third-party runtime dependencies in the core.
Does not manage human waits or persistent execution state.
02 / DOMAIN
Approvals and storage
Identity checks, sequential and structured graph workflows, task snapshots and history. JSON by default, with optional JDBC adapters.
Has its own dependencies. JDBC needs explicit wiring and migrations.
03 / EXPERIENCE
Hosts and clients
Spring Boot, Vue, RuoYi, and H5 examples demonstrate different integration approaches.
Client coverage varies. Examples are not a production-readiness guarantee.
en.capTitle:
Clear about what works.
Honest about what’s next.
en.capIntro: Know the gaps before you integrate. Open source should make that easier, too.
caps: Sequential reviews and structured payment graphs
SINGLE / ALL / ANY votes; conditional choice, parallel fork and paired join, with versions and task records.
Graphs are limited to standalone payment. Existing fixed-step routing covers payment, receiving and contracts. RuoYi and H5 do not gain graph support automatically.
Dynamic managers, withdrawal, reassignment, reminders, BPMN and automatic business writeback.
en.startTitle:
Next, run a request
of your own.
en.startIntro: Run the graph designer locally: edit, publish, submit a payment request, and watch independent tasks reach their join.
en.requirements: Linux / macOS / WSL · Git · Python 3.9+ · Full JDK 17+ · Maven 3.9+ · Node 22.22.2+ (22.x, with npm)
en.copyFail: Clipboard unavailable. Select and copy the commands manually.
en.runNote: The first run downloads dependencies. Wait for the ready URLs and read demo accounts from this run’s password file. Ctrl-C stops the services and deletes this run’s data. Use the manual setup guide if you need to retain data.
versions: Structured payment graphs are merged. Graph images come from accepted commit 9bb7a84a; older images retain their sources. Checked on 2026-10-12.
Earlier commit ab428327. Excludes graphs and other later main-branch updates.
Setup, graph boundaries, storage wiring, actual HTTP endpoints and executable synthetic examples.
en.closingBody: Read the code, run an example, share your use case.
en.footerDisclosure: A static project website, not an online approval service. No tracking scripts or data collection forms.
en.noJS: Content and source links work without JavaScript. Enable it for scenario tabs and full-screen images.
en.galleryLink: Explore travel, seal-use, receiving, payment and contract galleries
en.galleryNote: Five dedicated galleries, 104 historical original captures, each labeled by language, viewport and source.
en.conditionalGalleryLink: Explore conditional routing for payment, receiving and contracts
en.conditionalGalleryNote: 80 historical original screenshots across 20 capture states, covering the designer, partial approval decisions and final states.
en.screenAlt: ArcFlow graph designer with FIRST_MATCH amount routing, two independent review paths and a paired ALL join
en.graphStartLink: Start locally and open the graph workspace
en.graphBoundary: Current scope: standalone Spring Boot + Vue, payment graphs. Up to 32 nodes, 48 edges, 2 nested regions and 2–4 branches per region. No general BPMN, automatic RuoYi/H5 adoption or money movement.
en.graphRuntimeAlt: Payment runtime: business review completed, finance review still pending, and the ALL join shows 1 of 2 branches arrived
en.graphRuntimeCaption: A real running request: one branch has arrived, another is still working. The join cannot release early.
en.graphLaunchNote: After startup, sign in as Alice, open Process designer and choose Graph. Use Graph requests to submit synthetic payments. The screenshots here are not an interactive online demo.
